method.tables: Every gold model and every seed a gold table refers to. Tables not built in the local warehouse take their columns and keys from dbt.
method.keys: A primary key is the smallest set of key-like columns whose values are unique and never empty in the data.
method.relations: A table refers to another when it holds that table's whole primary key and at least 90 % of its distinct values exist there. Coverage is the measured share.
method.party: Party is a code shared by many tables; no table lists the parties.

tables.description: Type 1 employer dimension. Name fallbacks may merge unrelated employers; organization numbers are preferred.
Location dimension keyed by the complete source location tuple, including country to distinguish non-Swedish locations.
Type 1 occupation dimension retaining source taxonomy identifiers.
One current row per observed job advertisement, incrementally replaced on newly ingested payload changes. Not a vacancy count or active-ad snapshot.
One row per job and detected technology mention using seed regex patterns. Includes title, description and structured skills; does not establish requirements or proficiency.
Observed ad count by publication month, role, region and inferred seniority. Cohorts of collected ads, not historical market totals.
One row per month and role, counting distinct source advertisements. Missing coverage yields NULL official totals. Year comparisons need 12 preceding calendar months.

One row per month, role and technology. Counts, distinct known employers, shares, calendar-aligned growth and weighted three-month shares. total_ads is repeated per skill and must not be summed across skills.
One row per role and technology comparing complete baseline/comparison years. Annual shares use counts, not averages of monthly percentages.
Reviewable lower-case regex patterns. Fabric requires Microsoft or MS context to reduce false positives.
Occupation fields (yrkesområden), with their latest label.
Occupation groups (SSYK 4) as the ads name them, each in its occupation field.
The archives counted, with their source URL, SHA-256 and number of ads.
Ads per occupation field and year by employment type, working hours and required experience; field_id 'all' is every field together.
New ads and vacancies per month and occupation field; field_id 'all' is the whole market.
Ads per occupation group and year, in full and over the months the latest year covers (ads_ytd), with the year before over the same months.
Ads per county, occupation field and year; field_id 'all' is every field together.
News items (SVT, Ekot, the Government) with the parties and topics they concern, and whether they are political.
Each party a news item names, by a party term or by the full name of a politician in office (via).
Each topic a news item is about.
The latest fetch of each news source and when it last succeeded.
Governments since 1991, from seeds/parliament/governments.csv with a source per row.
Riksmöten with roll calls, the election each followed and the government at its first roll call.
Government studies (SOU, Ds) and the ministry memoranda bills name as preparation.
Government bills since 2006/07.
The committee reports each bill was dealt with in.
The studies each bill names in its preparation, with the sentence that names them.

Riksdag election results, Sweden, 1973 to the latest election. SCB where it has published, Valmyndigheten otherwise. Ny demokrati's votes (1991, 1994) are inside OTHER in SCB's tables; its seats are its own row.
SCB's party preference survey (PSU) with its margin of error.
Each party's members' votes and position on each roll call, with the party's role that day.
Every roll call since 1993/94. Grain: session x roll_call_id (vote id, plus ':motiv' for a roll call on the reasons for a decision rather than the decision itself).
Share of decisions on which two parties took the same position, per riksmöte.
Attendance, unity, winning side and voting with the government, per party and riksmöte (decisions only).

One row per budget year: governing and agreement parties, the adopted proposal, the completeness of imported expenditure frames, and the exact FiU1 point 2 roll call. Delivered as gold/marts/budget-context.json by platform/publish/export_po

Age bands as sources publish them. Bands from different sources overlap and are compared only like with like.
ESS participating countries.
Calendar, one row per day 1968-2030. Also the semantic layer's time spine.
ICD-10 chapters as grouped by Försäkringskassan, plus F43 inside F00-F99.
Every indicator in fct_indicator, with unit, welfare domain and direction.

Reporting periods: year (2024), quarter (2024-Q1), month (2024-03), pooled_years (2021-2024, Folkhälsomyndigheten's county results) and survey_round (ESS11). start_date and end_date join dim_date; reference_year aligns periods of different
Swedish regions on SCB codes: country 00, counties (2 digits), municipalities (4 digits), AKU's aggregate 0050 and the eight NUTS2 areas used by ESS.
Riksdag decisions that changed taxes from 2016, with bill, report and origin.
Estimated VAT per household type and spending group (SCB HUT and VAT rates).
Local income tax, burial and church fee rates per parish and year (Skatteverket).
The studies a tax decision's bill names as its preparation.
Each party's vote on each tax decision, in the first substantive roll call of its report.
Tax revenue per country, year and tax type (OECD Revenue Statistics), share of GDP and national currency.
Labour taxation per country, year, household type and wage level (OECD Taxing Wages).
Nationella folkhälsoenkäten (Folkhälsomyndigheten): share with 95% interval and responses.
All headline values on one grain. The table to join across domains.
Kolada key figures by municipality, county and country.
AKU labour force survey (SCB). Rate denominator depends on labour_status: employment and participation over population, unemployment over labour force.
Population on 31 December (SCB). The total over sexes is derived and flagged.
Started and ongoing sick-leave cases (Försäkringskassan). F43 is inside F00-F99; never add them.
Sjukpenningtal 2.0 (Försäkringskassan), monthly from 2021, rolling twelve months.
European Social Survey, weighted by pspwght, per country and round. Intervals ignore the sampling design and are too narrow.
European Social Survey for Sweden by NUTS2 area, rounds 5 onward.
Model features per county and year: value, one- and two-year lags, one-year change and gap to the country. Backward-looking only; no imputation.
County by year, indicators side by side. Descriptive co-variation only, not cause and effect.

Counties and the country by calendar year, one column per measure, each aggregated by its rule. For regression, correlation and maps. Carries numerators and denominators (unemployed and labour force, sick-pay days and insured) so regions co

ESS weighted means per country and round, plus pooled NORDIC and EU27 groups computed from respondents with the analysis weight. Compare rounds within a country only with survey_mode in view (ESS10 self-completion).
Municipalities by year with the Kolada key figures and population.
Sweden by month for time-series work: AKU (adjusted, unadjusted, trend), sick-pay rate and components, started cases with rolling twelve-month sums, psychiatric share, and ongoing cases.
